source_text: Controversies persist, including critiques of trial methodologies—such as early termination potentially inflating efficacy estimates and inadequate controls for viral load or partner HIV status—but these have been rebutted by reanalyses and subsequent programmatic evaluations showing sustained population-level impacts without methodological collapse.
